警視廳統計書 1925

Keishichō tōkeisho (Statistical Report of the Metropolitan Police Board), 大正14年 (1925)
警視總監官房文書課 (Secretariat, Superintendent-General of the Metropolitan Police), 東京, 1926 (大正15年12月20日發行)

All 264 numbered tables are transcribed (table 19 in its two printed parts); the printed contents are given as the table of contents. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from full-resolution crops, with no checking by eye; the cells left unreadable in the twelve tables with more than four of them were read again blind (without the first reading or the totals) by Claude Opus 5.5, which settled 120 of 155. The scan is small and soft, and the column next to the binding or the page edge is often clipped, so some tables have runs of [?] in that column. Where a 3 could be an 8 and only one reading makes the printed total reconcile — the cell being the only doubtful one in that sum — that reading is used and noted. Printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. 123 of about 127,000 filled cells could not be read and are marked [?].
